text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes had 
finally arrived. Following the buzz from 
the dramatic training video...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan receives fervent support even 
from fans of a completely different 
demographic than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, today's race opponent is Nishino 
Flower, a formidable rival whose 
popularity is blowing up on Umatter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan was determined to defeat her 
and prove who truly was the cutest of them 
all.
